description: LocalFilesystem put_if_version_matches performs a non-atomic read/compare followed by put, allowing multiple concurrent writers with one token to return :ok and overwrite each other. See linked GitHub issue for reproduction and success criteria.

comments.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/issues/302. Blocks bedrock-7i1 / #296 because recovery generation reservation requires a true single-winner CAS primitive. Independent reproduction: eight same-token writers produced six :ok results.

title: Make LocalFilesystem version-matched writes atomic
